meta.description: Candor consultant operations: fulfillment, warehouse shipping, and invoicing Candor. Consultation notes are not stored here.

login.description: Sign in with an operator account.

workbench.title: Overview
workbench.subtitleFirm: Work in fulfillment order. Consultation transcripts are not in this system.
workbench.subtitlePlatform: Platform view of Younger, Dashu Pharmacy, and Young Lion Pharmacy queues.

module.hintFirm: Consultation notes stay off this admin. Use it for required ticks, selections, shipping, and invoicing Candor.
module.hintPlatform: Mock data. Candor can see every consultant firm; a firm login only sees its own work.

firm.cases: Paid and booked handoffs. Routed by report reading / lab assist / personalized products.
firm.labs: Lab-assist and personalized-product cases without a report: schedule the blood test and wait.
firm.progress: Tick the required form stages so Candor can track progress. Not consultation notes.
firm.products: Catalog and stock on one page: names, Candor shipping labels, on-hand qty, and cost.
firm.selections: Personalized-product plans only. Which items and qty to ship for this case — not purchasing, not editing the catalog.
firm.shipping: Pick → apply the Candor label → ship / tracking number → deduct stock.
firm.reports: Shipped items, qty, and cost for reconciliation.
firm.users: Colleague accounts and access. Admins can invite or adjust.
firm.settings: Notification inbox, warehouse, and Candor label versions. Fulfillment work is not here.

platform.cases: Paid and booked handoffs from Candor. Filter by consultant firm and plan.
platform.labs: mid / premium without a report: the firm schedules the blood test and waits.
platform.progress: Firms tick required form stages so Candor can track progress. Not consultation notes.
platform.products: Each firm’s catalog and stock: names, Candor labels, on-hand qty, and cost.
platform.selections: Premium only. Which items and qty to ship for this case — not purchasing, not editing the catalog.
platform.shipping: Pick → apply Candor label → ship / tracking number → deduct stock.
platform.invoices: After fulfillment, the firm invoices Candor. Not Candor’s revenue-share ledger.
platform.reports: Shipped items, qty, and cost. Candor sees all firms; each firm sees only itself.
platform.orgs: Current partners: Younger, Dashu Pharmacy, Young Lion Pharmacy. Firm staff never see this list.
platform.users: Candor platform accounts and people at each consultant firm. Roles decide view vs edit.
platform.settings: Platform notices and Candor label versions. Fulfillment work lives in the left-hand flow.

reviews.title: Clinical review
reviews.subtitleFirm: Human review and clinical judgement. The engine is not connected yet.
reviews.subtitlePlatform: FigJam hexagon gates. The engine is not connected yet — the slot for Younger, Dashu Pharmacy, and Young Lion Pharmacy reviews.
reviews.noteFirm: This is not shipping or invoice approval. Consultation content still stays off this admin.
reviews.notePlatform: This is not shipping or invoice approval. Consultation content still stays off this admin. These rows are human clinical review / clinical judgement.
reviews.manualHint: After a result, confirm it is usable.
reviews.clinicalHint: After training or version compare, decide whether the clinical outcome is acceptable.
reviews.emptyDetail: Select a review on the left to approve or return it.

selections.confirmHint: Expand a case to pick items. Confirm stores the time and moves the case to shipping. You can still return it before it is sent.
selections.confirmBody: The case will move to shipping. You can still return it before it is in transit.
selections.unconfirmBody: Confirmation will be cleared and the case goes back to selection. In-transit cases cannot be returned.
selections.notConfirmed: Not confirmed yet — items and qty can still change

progress.label: Candor label on
progress.tickHint: Tick only the required stages. Keep LINE / video consult notes off this admin.

reports.monthHint: Includes historical demo shipments for reconciliation preview.

settings.intro: Settings cover notification email, the default warehouse, and which Candor label version to apply. Fulfillment work lives in the left-hand flow.
settings.noticeHint: Missing items, low stock, and invoice status go to this inbox (demo — no real email yet).
settings.warehouseHint: Picking and shipping start from this warehouse.
settings.labelsHintFirm: Apply the Candor label before shipping. “Current” is the version to use now.
settings.labelsHintPlatform: Goods belong to the consultant firm; Candor labels are applied before shipping. “Current” is the version to use now.

actions.confirmBody: It will be removed from this demo list.
actions.confirmAgainBody: This cannot be undone. Press delete once more to remove it.
actions.inUse: This SKU is used in a selection or shipment, so it cannot be deleted.
actions.selfDelete: You cannot delete your own account.

form.noDueCases: No invoice-due cases for this firm.
form.emptyDetail: Select a row on the left to view or edit.

users.inviteHint: Invite a colleague by email and choose a role. Select someone on the left to edit on the right.
users.emptyDetail: Select a person on the left, or invite someone.

shipping.expandHint: Expand a case to see its shipping timeline. Item thumbnails stay at the top.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Candor assist edits are recorded here. Day-to-day ticks by firm ops are not.
